mcqs.question: Which of the following motherboard types is NOT a smaller version of ATX?
options: Micro-ATX
Mini-ITX
BTX
AT

mcqs.question: Which statement is correct regarding the characteristics of AT motherboards?
options: AT motherboards are easy to upgrade and maintain.
AT motherboards are large-sized and older technology.
AT motherboards support modern processors and expansion cards.
AT motherboards are compact and low power consumption.
mcqs.answer: AT motherboards are large-sized and older technology.
